$comment: Constructed from ISO 20022 pacs.008 concepts; see ../provenance.json.

accept_dt.description: Calendar date on which the payment instruction was accepted.

cdtr_iban.description: International account number of the party receiving the funds.

cdtr_nm.description: Name of the party to which the funds are due.

dbtr_iban.description: International account number of the party that owes the funds.

dbtr_nm.description: Name of the party that owes the transferred funds.

e2e_ref.description: Reference assigned by the initiating party to follow the payment end to end.

instd_amt.description: Amount ordered by the initiating party before deduction of charges.

instd_ccy.description: ISO currency code for the amount ordered by the initiating party.

msg_ref.description: Point-to-point reference assigned to identify the payment message.

sttlm_dt.description: Calendar date on which interbank settlement makes funds available.
